newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SEMA PLANS GDR ISSUE TO BOOST CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SEMA PLANS GDR ISSUE TO BOOST CAPITAL.

text.p: Lithuanian spirits producer Sema said on Friday that it would boost its capital with an 18 million litas share issue and that most of it would be distributed in the form of gross depository receipts (GDRs).

"The general shareholders' meeting today voted for a share capital increase of 18 million litas...and most of it will be issued abroad as GDRs," Sema's general director, Gediminas Sargunas, told Reuters.

The company's share capital is currently 15.9 million litas and the state has a 27.14 percent stake. It earlier decided to increase its share capital to 20.7 million litas from reserves, a process which is being carried out now.

"When this new share issue is registered at the securities commission, the current shareholders have the right for one month to buy a percentage of the issue which equals their current stake," he said.
"The state's representative confirmed that the state will not particpate in the increase and we forecast that the other shareholders will only buy around five percent of the issue," he said.
He added that the rest will be issued as GDRs.
He also said that Williams de Broe had offered to manage the GDR issue.
Sema is on the Vilnius bourse's A list and is considered to be a strong candidate for inclusion on the official list.
Its trade was suspended on April 15 for up to three months while the current share increase takes place.
Vilniaus Bank and Birzai Dairy last year distributed the first GDR issues from Lithuania.
